Ivy K.: Quick kickoff for PulseCheck launch social push. Deliverables: 2 X posts (AM/PM), LinkedIn thread, hero image, 30s clip, and SDR seed rules. Who picks up?
Ben S.: I can do scheduling + SDR routing. Plan: X AM metric lead, X PM customer quote, LinkedIn thread midday unpacking config tips. Also want an A/B headline on LinkedIn opener.
Rita M.: I'll draft copy. Tone: concise, product-led with a single customer stat.
Rita M.: Copy variants:
Variant 1: "Cut inference spend 33% while keeping p95 <170ms. Replay + configs: [link]"
Variant 2: "Same latency, way lower cost. See the replay + config pack. [link]"
Noah T.: Design ask: hero 1200x628 PNG, square thumbnail for carousel, 30s mp4 (16:9). Need raw slides/screens by EOD.
Ivy K.: SDR seedlist: webinar attendees (auto), replay clickers (UTM), active trials (last 14d), named accounts. Route AE queue for ARR > $10k or Strategic tag. Ben, can you add rules?
Ben S.: Yes. Seed rules: attendees->SDR-Base, replay_clickers+active_trials->SDR-Adv, named+ARR>10k->AE. Will push to CRM and flag #sales-inbound. Canonical UTM: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedIn&utm_campaign=pulsecheck_launch_q2 (use exact).
sched-bot: Posts queued: X AM (Variant1) 2026-06-02T08:30Z, X PM (Variant2) 2026-06-02T17:30Z, LinkedIn thread 2026-06-02T11:00Z. No conflicts.
Rita M.: Draft LinkedIn thread opener: "How we shrank per-inference spend without trading latency. TL;DR: batching + targeted cache + tuned kernels. Replay + config pack: [link]"
Noah T.: Uploaded hero v1 -> https://drive.example/pulsecheck/hero_v1.png. I'll push v2 with bolder delta by EOD.
Ivy K.: Please add a pinned reply on X: "Want the config + test scripts? DM us or click replay" to capture infra leads. Ben will brief SDRs to watch DMs and UTM clickers.
Ben S.: I'll set a 60min watch window after AM post and escalate hot leads to AE. Owners: Rita(copy), Noah(design/video), Ben(schedule+routing), Ivy(campaign). Check back when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
